title: OSB Group completes £25.9m Manchester refinance in 21 days
summary:
OSB Group has completed a £25.9 million mixed-use refinance for a property developer in Manchester, funding a scheme comprising 93 apartments and basement commercial space at Barclay House. The lender moved from formal offer to completion in 21 days, with funding arriving just over a month after the initial referral.

title: Edinburgh Georgian townhouse conversion yields double-digit return
summary:
Develop North PLC has completed a £1.25 million hotel financing transaction in Edinburgh, converting a Georgian townhouse into a 16-bedroom hotel that has since been refinanced through a long-term commercial mortgage. The real estate investment company provided the funding to AM Number Three Ltd in March 2025, secured against 3 John's Place in Leith.

title: Mortgage product shelf-life falls to 13 days in October
summary:
The average shelf-life for mortgage products fell to 13 days in October, down from 14 days in September, according to Moneyfacts data. For 2026 as a whole, mortgage product shelf-life has averaged just 15 days, marking the shortest annual average on record as lenders respond to volatile swap rates.

title: Estate agents sceptical of Budget support for housing market
summary:
A survey of estate agents reveals widespread doubt that the upcoming Budget will deliver meaningful support for the housing market. Research by GetAgent found that 84% of agents are sceptical about whether the Chancellor will introduce measures to stimulate property sales.

title: Downsizers seek £108k equity release to justify move
summary:
Homeowners in the UK would need to release an average of £108,516 from their property to consider downsizing worthwhile, according to new research from Barclays. The bank's survey of 2,000 people found that a quarter of homeowners are open to downsizing, but seven in 10 cite financial risks and upfront costs as barriers.

title: Majority of landlords unaware of mandatory register
summary:
More than three-quarters of landlords in England remain unaware of the new mandatory property register being introduced later this year. The survey found that only 23% of property owners knew about the requirement to register on the database under the Renters' Rights Act.

The post Majority of landlords unaware of mandatory register appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Estate agent director fined £12,500 for fire safety failures
summary:
The director of a Hastings-based estate agency has been fined £12,500 for failing to provide information to fire safety inspectors following a serious incident. The total penalties, including company fines and costs, amount to £24,525.31.

title: Birmingham agency expands lettings team amid rental growth
summary:
Partridge Homes has appointed Katie Fisher as property manager, the third addition to its lettings division since May 2026. The Birmingham-based agency agreed close to 40 new rentals in September 2026 alone, marking its strongest year since 2007.

The post Birmingham agency expands lettings team amid rental growth appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: First-time buyers face higher mortgage costs than rent
summary:
More than half of first-time buyers in the UK are now paying higher monthly mortgage costs than they previously paid in rent, according to research from estate agent Hamptons. The proportion reached 56% last month, the highest level in at least a decade, as mortgage rates climbed above 6% for the first time in three years.

title: Bridging finance secures historic Norfolk pub acquisition
summary:
A specialist lender has provided £244,000 in bridging finance to facilitate the purchase of a Grade II listed public house in Swanton Morley, Norfolk. The deal uses a combination of first-charge commercial and second-charge residential bridging finance.
